certificate: G is the conservative nominal-slot residual certificate; G_prime tests internal marked nominal slots in every cyclic residual SCC. Physical dynamics identify duplicate parents.
control: Synchronous permanent zero-valued pins; all vertices eligible; convergence from every compatible physical initial state; unit costs.

J1.description: Asymmetric COPY/AND degree association, unchanged from original J1

matching: Uniform permutation of prescribed output source-label multiset into labeled input slots; self-loops and repeated parents are retained without rejection.
network_hash: SHA256 of parents converted to little-endian int64 row-major bytes followed by three uint8 rule columns row-major bytes.
preflight: Fresh independent exhaustive two-node oracle and edge-case checks, production engine/solver comparison on deterministic small fixtures, and independent protocol/code audit before launch.
protocol_integrity: The protocol, seed list and current source identities are checked against integrity_record.json and SHA256_MANIFEST.json before production.
records: Every replicate has seed entropy, full-network hash, both degree-class eight-code counts, residual rows, residual/cyclic SCC size lists, G/G_prime, costs or bounds, solver work/stops and a feasible upper witness. All 20000 draws retained.
replay: Independently reconstruct and validate all20000 full networks; use structurally certified copy optima and independent physical enumeration of all complex component optima; validate every feasible witness.
replicates: 0 through 19999 inclusive; exactly one retained record per identity
rng_call_sequence: Degree-one vertices 0..12799, degree-three vertices 12800..25599; degrees int64.
Expand corner code bits0,1,2 into three uint8 columns; no subsequent stochastic call.

statistics.comparison: Original2000 and replication20000 observations shown separately; no pooled replacement. Any between-batch contrast is exploratory because J1 was selected after examining the original sample. Intervals describe finite-size quantities; asymptotic references do not define an exact finite-n null.
statistics.fixed_reference: lambda=29/80,rho=19/40,mu=-log(51/80),m2=mu+mu^2,P0=51/80, derived only from declared probabilities; never refitted to observed rules.
statistics.moments: All-draw endpoint averages for C and C^2; unbiased endpoint sample variances divided by M for squared SE; pointwise approximate95% normal envelope using z=Phi^-1(.975).
statistics.no_refit_check: Deliberately changed diagnostic frequency inputs must leave reference references and cost summaries unchanged.
statistics.probabilities: Definite/possible zero-cost counts and G/G_prime failure counts with pointwise95% Clopper-Pearson intervals/envelopes.
statistics.rule_diagnostics: Per-degree eight-code aggregate counts; impossible categories must be zero. Report degreewise Pearson chi-square(df3), joint chi-square(df6), and Bonferroni95% Clopper-Pearson bounds for8 positive probabilities. These diagnostics do not authorize exclusion or resampling.

unresolved: Retain every interval and stop reason; never use solved-only averages, imputation, selection, rerolling or outcome-based continuation. A validation failure triggers an audit, not a replacement draw.
work_unit: One local-row evaluation constructing successors or one controlled successor-edge traversal; budget per complex SCC, no wall-clock cutoff.
